args: Prepare ONLY placement of the held Cream carton into the same upright patterned bowl. Check retained identity and the rigid, originally table-supported rectangular carton model. From the supplied historical checkpoint VALUES select four actually measured top-boundary world XYZ arrays by corner_paths, ordered c0,c1,c2,c3 around the perimeter. c0,c1 must be the currently visible short end at the start of the Cream logo; assign persistent physical corner_ids, not screen directions. Paths start with the checkpoint key. table_path selects an actually measured bare-table XYZ array from the prelift records. extent_uncertainty_path selects the largest documented scalar metre uncertainty relevant to those boundary coordinates, if present; otherwise return an empty path. Do not select a squared error or a dimension as uncertainty. Do not synthesize coordinates, select a cross section as a full length, or certify undocumented historical corners. Return unknown if references are inadequate. In the CURRENT images request p0,p1,p2,p3 as separated interior depth samples of the planar printed top, avoiding fingers and seams. end_pixels are the CURRENT two visible end corners c0,c1 in end_camera; these are boundary rays, not depth samples. The hidden opposite end need not be visible. For the bowl request s0,s1,s2,s3 on separated depth-valid TOP LIP surface patches, floor on its visible interior floor, and b0,b1 on two distinct recognizable bowl pattern landmarks; describe their physical identities in bowl_mark_ids. Return about eight well-distributed CURRENT inner-opening boundary pixels in rim_pixels and rim_camera, not the outer silhouette or a lower interior contour. Confirm a circular horizontal inner lip only if actually supported. Current bowl landmark mode is landmarks. No motion yet. Use English ASCII. Missing or occluded evidence must be unknown, never a stationary projection.

fresh_effect.visible_extent: Agentview shows a labeled carton portion projecting below the fingers with a table gap. The wrist view shows the broad printed surface and far short edge between the fingers; the near portion is hidden by robot self-occlusion. A full perimeter is not visible.

result.explanation: Preparation only; no motion or placement success is asserted. The visible Cream print, carton/table separation, and documented surface translation matching the lift support retained identity, not merely closed fingers. The selected precontact records contain four full top-boundary corners, supported by planar top, sidewall and bare-table measurements; they are not the later transverse cross section. Side A is the physical long edge joining historical corners 0 and 3; side B joins 1 and 2. The current visible logo-start end matches c0,c1. Its boundary is the printed top/end-wall junction, not the farther end-wall silhouette. The opposite end is currently robot-occluded; no current location is assigned to it. The selected 0.00149871 m uncertainty is the largest documented prelift boundary uncertainty and is heuristic, not a confidence bound. The upright bowl and visible oval inner opening support the circular horizontal inner-lip hypothesis locally. Lip samples target the narrow upper rim surface; rim_pixels target the inner opening boundary. Fresh depth validity and model residuals still require measurement, especially at the thin lip. Historical images are not supplied here, so historical geometry is supported by the supplied measurement records rather than independent rereading of those images. No hidden-clearance certificate is claimed.
